name: Cade Parian
title: Personal Injury Lawyer
lead: I hate to sound like a country song, but a lot of them tell the truth. The people of west Georgia and east Alabama are my people. We get each other. I understand the hardships that a death, injury, or arrest can cause these folks. I am one of them. Dig hard. Get dirty. Complete the job.
bio: When you call Cade Parian, you understand what it means to 'Call Cade. Get Paid!' He is not a traditional attorney and The Parian Lawyers is not a traditional law firm. Cade Parian's clients call him personable, compassionate, and aggressive. While these traits rarely go together for most people, they are what you want from your attorney. You need an attorney who will fight for you to the end while understanding the toll your situation is taking on you and your family. Other lawyers know Cade Parian's abilities. He has been recognized countless times by some of the top attorney organizations in America. Despite all the accolades (or 'shiny stuff' as Cade calls them), he has remained true to his west Georgia roots. In his own words, Parian says

Giving back to the community is important to Cade. After all, he is a 3 generation resident of Carrollton. He has been called upon by the Chancellor of the University System of Georgia twice to help select the President of the University of West Georgia. He also served as President of the University of West Georgia Athletic Foundation. He currently serves on the Board of Directors of Partners Advancing Student Success, a nonprofit serving at-risk students in Carroll County. You can find out more about Cade's community efforts by visiting www.cadecares.org.

A common lawyer joke is that lawyers love to hear themselves talk. Guess what? Cade admits it! His public speaking skills are well-regarded. He has hosted events all over west Georgia that have raised hundreds of thousands of dollars for local charities and organizations. Just like he is not afraid to ask a jury for money, he is not scared to ask a crowd of 500 at a charity auction event for a donation. You can also hear him every Friday night on WCKS-FM 102.7 patrolling the sidelines of Carrollton Trojan football games.

Cade and his family live in Carrollton, Georgia. He has represented people in 42 states. Where you are located is no obstacle for Cade or Parian Injury Law, LLC. We meet you how you want to be met. Call us today to set up a meeting to discuss your issue. Whether it is personal injury, workers comp, or criminal defense, we have you covered.
awards: Cade Parian has been named a “Rising Star” by Super Lawyers and Atlanta Magazines since 2012. This honor is bestowed upon only 2.5% of the practicing attorneys in Georgia.
Based upon client reviews, The Parian Lawyers has a perfect 10.0 rating on AVVO, the nation’s leading website for attorney searches.

The Fulton County Daily Report, Georgia’s daily legal newspaper, honored Cade Parian as one of the “Top 40 Legal Professionals Under 40” in the State of Georgia. This is one of the highest honors bestowed upon lawyers in the state.

Cade Parian was named “Top 40 Under 40” by The National Trial Lawyers is an organization composed of the premier trial lawyers from across the country. Membership into The National Trial Lawyers: Top 40 under 40 is by invitation only, and is extended exclusively to those individuals who meet stringent qualifications and specialize in the legal practice of civil plaintiff.

name: Tyler Paul Smith
title: Personal Injury Lawyer
bio: Tyler Paul Smith (or 'TP' as we like to call him) is as west Georgia as they come. He was born and raised in Haralson County, Georgia where he lives on his family's 160+ year old farm. Saying that his roots run deep in the area is an understatement.

He is a skilled litigator ready to take on any case that requires courtroom advocacy. His simple upbringing equips him with the ability to take on complex legal matters and boil them down into simple terms. His clients appreciate his ability to do so.

His dedication to the communities of west Georgia is also impressive. In 2020, Tyler Paul was elected to Georgia's House of Representatives representing residents of Carroll and Haralson Counties. While most politicians only like the shaking hands part of politics, Tyler Paul dove into his first legislative session headfirst sponsoring legislation that led to criminal probation reform aimed at helping those convicted of crimes. He also sponsored numerous bills aimed at helping residents of his district.
He earned his undergraduate degree from The Citadel: The Military College of South Carolina and his law degree from Atlanta's John Marshall Law School.

Like all the attorneys and staff of Parian Injury Law, LLC, Tyler Paul is ready to meet you wherever to help with your legal needs. We can come to you; you can come to us; we can set up a Zoom meeting; we can meet how YOU the client want to meet.

You can reach Tyler Paul Smith by calling (404) 795-5035 or chatting right now from this website below. Whether it's personal injury, workers comp, criminal defense, or any other legal matter — call Tyler Paul.

name: Ryan Farmer
title: Personal Injury Lawyer
bio: Ryan Farmer calls west Georgia home. He lives in Tallapoosa with his wife, Chelsea, who is an elementary school teacher in the Haralson County School System. Ryan currently represents District 4 on the Haralson County Board of Commissioners. He is also President of the Tallapoosa Bar Association.
He earned his undergraduate degree from the University of North Georgia and his law degree from Mercer University.

Ryan is a skilled negotiator. He worked under the Gold Dome of the Georgia State Capitol for many years where he served as general counsel to the Senate Majority Leader and counsel to the House Republican Caucus.

He is based in our Bremen, Georgia office. However, like all the attorneys and staff of Parian Lawyers, Ryan is ready to meet you wherever to help with your legal needs. We can come to you; you can come to us; we can set up a Zoom meeting; we can meet how YOU the client wants to meet.
